station.title: Station

platform.title: Platform
platform.description:
Choose which platform at {stop_name} to show departures for, or leave blank for all platforms.

The list is built from the departures TfL is reporting right now ({platform_count} platform(s) found). If the platform you want isn't listed — for example because nothing is due there at the moment — you can type it in; the filter matches on the platform name as TfL reports it, with the "Platform " prefix removed (e.g. "Eastbound - 2" or "14"). For bus stops this is the route number.

data_description.direction: Elizabeth line only. Keeps every train heading this way, worked out from TfL's route data rather than the platform or destination, so it keeps working when trains are diverted to another platform, change destination by time of day or terminate early. Usually the simplest choice, e.g. Westbound from Stratford for all trains to Liverpool Street. Leave blank for both directions. Changing this gives the sensor a new entity ID.
data_description.calling_at: Elizabeth line only. Keeps only trains whose route from here passes through (or ends at) this station, e.g. Stratford from Liverpool Street, which leaves out Abbey Wood trains. Stations with two parts on the line, Liverpool Street (Elizabeth line and main line) and Paddington, are listed once and match both, including trains diverted to terminate at the main line station during disruption. TfL doesn't publish each train's stopping pattern, so this follows the route to the train's destination. If you also set a direction, it must be the direction this station lies in. Leave blank for all. Changing this gives the sensor a new entity ID.
data_description.platform: Elizabeth line: leave this blank and use Direction of travel or Calling at instead. In central London TfL reports most trains as "Platform Unknown", and some stations (e.g. Stratford) report the same platform as a number for some trains and "Unknown" for others, so a platform filter silently drops trains.

strikes.title: Strike alerts
strikes.description:
Adds three entities that track strikes announced by TfL, checked hourly from TfL's own status data:

- **London TfL strikes**: when the next strike starts, with every announced strike (dates, lines, TfL's description) in its attributes.
- **London TfL strike today**: on when a strike affects any of your lines today.
- **London TfL strike within 7 days**: on when a strike is under way or starts within the next 7 days.

The README has ready-made dashboard cards for them.

data_description.enabled: Turn off to remove the strike entities.
data_description.lines: Leave empty to watch every Tube, Elizabeth line, Overground, DLR and tram line ({line_count} lines). Strikes are announced per line, so pick the ones you travel on to ignore the rest.
